name: How does an AI audit improve data security for law firms?
description: An AI audit improves data security by identifying vulnerabilities in AI systems, ensuring compliance with data protection laws, and recommending safeguards.

mainEntity.name: How does an AI audit improve data security for law firms?

acceptedAnswer.text: An AI audit enhances data security by thoroughly examining how AI systems handle sensitive client information. It identifies vulnerabilities in data storage, transmission, and access protocols used by AI tools. The audit ensures that AI integrations comply with data protection laws and industry best practices, recommending safeguards to prevent breaches and unauthorized access, thereby bolstering the firm's overall cybersecurity posture.
